mapper.select: select count(*) from ch_student where status = '0'
select count(distinct student_id) from ch_exam_record where ifnull(record_status, '2') <> '1'
select count(*) from ch_appointment where status = #{status}
select count(*) from ch_appointment where date(appointment_time) = curdate() and status not in ('2', '3')
select count(distinct student_id) from ch_exam_record where ifnull(record_status, '2') <> '1' and (bmi_level in ('2', '3') or systolic_pressure >= 140 or diastolic_pressure >= 90)
select ifnull(bmi_level, '9') as bmiLevel, count(*) as num from ch_exam_record where ifnull(record_status, '2') <> '1' group by bmi_level order by bmi_level

select '血压' as item, count(distinct student_id) as num from ch_exam_record where ifnull(record_status, '2') <> '1' and (systolic_pressure >= 140 or diastolic_pressure >= 90) union all select 'BMI', count(distinct student_id) from ch_exam_record where ifnull(record_status, '2') <> '1' and bmi_level in ('2', '3') union all select '视力', count(distinct student_id) from ch_exam_record where ifnull(record_status, '2') <> '1' and (vision_left < 4.8 or vision_right < 4.8) union all select '心率', count(distinct student_id) from ch_exam_record where ifnull(record_status, '2') <> '1' and (heart_rate < 60 or heart_rate > 100)
select id as batchId, batch_name as batchName, capacity as capacity, booked_count as bookedCount, status as status from ch_exam_batch order by exam_date, id

select a.id as id, s.student_no as studentNo, s.student_name as studentName, b.batch_name as batchName, date_format(a.appointment_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as appointmentTime, a.status as status from ch_appointment a left join ch_student s on s.id = a.student_id left join ch_exam_batch b on b.id = a.batch_id order by a.id desc limit 6
